2. Operational Findings
The extraction pipeline must preserve the
logical reading order even when the visual
layout introduces competing text regions.
EXTRACTION WARNING
This callout sits between logical paragraphs
and is intended to interrupt visual flow.
The first column contains narrative findings,
reviewer observations, and artificially broken words
such as imple￾mentation, docu￾ment, extra￾ction, and multi￾column. These line fragments are intentional and
should not be silently normalized when evaluating
raw extraction fidelity.
The system should distinguish a genuine line break
from a paragraph boundary. It should also preserve
punctuation, unusual whitespace, and inline
references such as [2].
Finding 2.1. The body continues beneath a secondary
annotation region. The annotation itself is not part of
the paragraph.
MARGIN NOTE
OCR CHECK — compare O/0
and I/1/l.
A synthetic identifier such as TXN_98402_07 appears in the
prose, followed by a URL-like token
https://example.invalid/ref/98402 and a mailbox-like string
review@example.invalid.
Additional prose is included to create realistic
density. The benchmark should reward systems that
identify semantic continuity rather than simply
reading objects in x/y coordinate order.
